local OfflineFiles = {}
OfflineFiles.resources = EMBEDDED_FILES

function OfflineFiles.create(host, encodedFiles)
	encodedFiles = encodedFiles or EMBEDDED_FILES

	host = {
		readfile = host.readfile, writefile = host.writefile, isfile = host.isfile,
		makefolder = host.makefolder, isfolder = host.isfolder,
		getcustomasset = host.getcustomasset or host.getsynasset,
	}

	local decodedFiles = {}
	local modifiedFiles = {}
	local exportedFiles = {}
	local assetHandles = {}
	local files = {}

	function files.isfile(path)
		path = OfflineFiles._pathKey(path)

		if modifiedFiles[path] ~= nil or encodedFiles[path] ~= nil then
			return true
		end

		return host.isfile and host.isfile(OfflineFiles._physicalPath(path)) or false
	end

	function files.readfile(path)
		path = OfflineFiles._pathKey(path)

		if modifiedFiles[path] ~= nil then
			return modifiedFiles[path]
		end

		if encodedFiles[path] then
			if decodedFiles[path] == nil then
				decodedFiles[path] = buffer.tostring(OfflineFiles._decodeBuffer(encodedFiles[path]))
			end

			return decodedFiles[path]
		end

		local physicalPath = OfflineFiles._physicalPath(path)
		assert(host.readfile and host.isfile and host.isfile(physicalPath), "Local file unavailable: " .. path)
		return host.readfile(physicalPath)
	end

	function files.writefile(path, contents)
		path = OfflineFiles._pathKey(path)
		assert(type(contents) == "string", "File contents must be a string")

		modifiedFiles[path] = contents
		exportedFiles[path] = nil
		assetHandles[path] = nil

		if host.writefile then
			local target = OfflineFiles._physicalPath(path)
			OfflineFiles._makeFolders(host, target)
			host.writefile(target, contents)
		end
	end

	function files.appendfile(path, contents)
		local previous = files.isfile(path) and files.readfile(path) or ""
		files.writefile(path, previous .. contents)
	end

	function files.makefolder(path)
		OfflineFiles._makeFolders(host, OfflineFiles._physicalPath(path) .. "/")
	end

	function files.isfolder(path)
		path = OfflineFiles._pathKey(path) .. "/"

		for file in encodedFiles do
			if file:sub(1, #path) == path then
				return true
			end
		end

		return host.isfolder and host.isfolder(OfflineFiles._physicalPath(path)) or false
	end

	function files.getcustomasset(path)
		path = OfflineFiles._pathKey(path)
		local getAsset = host.getcustomasset or host.getsynasset
		assert(getAsset and host.writefile, "Executor needs getcustomasset and writefile for embedded media")

		if assetHandles[path] ~= nil then
			return assetHandles[path]
		end

		local target = OfflineFiles._physicalPath(path)

		if not exportedFiles[path] then
			OfflineFiles._makeFolders(host, target)
			host.writefile(target, files.readfile(path))
			exportedFiles[path] = true
		end

		local handle = getAsset(target)
		assetHandles[path] = handle
		return handle
	end

	files.getsynasset = files.getcustomasset
	return files
end

function OfflineFiles._pathKey(path)
	assert(type(path) == "string", "Local path must be a string")
	path = path:gsub("\\", "/"):gsub("^%./", "")
	assert(not path:find(":", 1, true) and path:sub(1, 1) ~= "/", "Absolute paths are unsupported")

	for part in path:gmatch("[^/]+") do
		assert(part ~= "..", "Parent paths are unsupported")
	end

	return path
end

function OfflineFiles._physicalPath(path)
	return "PulseHubOffline/" .. OfflineFiles._pathKey(path)
end

function OfflineFiles._makeFolders(host, path)
	if not host.makefolder then
		return
	end

	local current = ""

	for part in path:gmatch("([^/]+)/") do
		current = current == "" and part or current .. "/" .. part

		if not host.isfolder or not host.isfolder(current) then
			pcall(host.makefolder, current)
		end
	end
end

function OfflineFiles._decodeBuffer(text)
	local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
	local values = {}

	for index = 1, #alphabet do
		values[string.byte(alphabet, index)] = index - 1
	end

	local clean = string.gsub(text, "%s", "")
	assert(#clean % 4 == 0, "Invalid embedded buffer length")

	local padding = string.sub(clean, -2) == "==" and 2 or (string.sub(clean, -1) == "=" and 1 or 0)
	local result = buffer.create(#clean / 4 * 3 - padding)
	local output = 0

	for index = 1, #clean, 4 do
		local first, second, third, fourth = string.byte(clean, index, index + 3)
		local word = assert(values[first]) * 262144 + assert(values[second]) * 4096
			+ (values[third] or 0) * 64 + (values[fourth] or 0)

		for shift = 16, 0, -8 do
			if output < buffer.len(result) then
				buffer.writeu8(result, output, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(word, shift), 255))
				output += 1
			end
		end
	end

	return result
end

local ResourceData = {}

function ResourceData.hash(value)
	local hash = 2166136261
	for index = 1, #value, 5 do
		local mixed = bit32.bxor(hash, string.byte(value, index))
		hash = (mixed * 403 + bit32.lshift(mixed, 24)) % 4294967296
	end
	return hash
end

function ResourceData.create(environment)
	local state = {M = RESOURCE_MANIFEST, dir = "PulseHub/cache", prefFile = "PulseHub/cache/data_base.txt",
		mem = {}, busy = {}, fail = {}, down = {}, base = {}}
	state.hash = ResourceData.hash
	state.get = function(name)
		if state.mem[name] then return state.mem[name] end
		local entry = state.M[name]
		if not entry then return nil end
		local path = state.dir .. "/" .. entry[1]
		local ok, contents = pcall(environment.readfile, path)
		if not ok or type(contents) ~= "string" or #contents ~= entry[2] or ResourceData.hash(contents) ~= entry[3] then return nil end
		state.mem[name] = contents
		return contents
	end
	state.take = function(name)
		local contents = state.get(name)
		state.mem[name] = nil
		return contents
	end
	state.fetch = state.get
	state.prefetch = function(names)
		for _, name in names or {} do
			environment.task.spawn(function() pcall(state.get, name) end)
		end
	end
	return state
end

local OfflineRequests = {}

function OfflineRequests.address(value)
	if not value:find("://", 1, true) then
		return value
	end

	value = value:gsub("https?://www%.roblox%.com/asset/%?id=(%d+)", "rbxassetid://%1")
	return (value:gsub("https?://", "offline://"))
end

function OfflineRequests.request(context, options)
	assert(type(options) == "table" and type(options.Url) == "string", "Request needs a URL")
	local url = OfflineRequests.address(options.Url)
	local body = OfflineRequests._body(context, url)

	if body == nil then
		local route = tostring(url):match("^[^?]+") or tostring(url)
		context.blocked[OfflineRequests.address(route)] = true
		return {Success = false, StatusCode = 503, StatusMessage = "Unavailable offline", Body = "", Headers = {}}
	end

	return {Success = true, StatusCode = 200, StatusMessage = "Local", Body = body, Headers = {}}
end

function OfflineRequests._body(context, url)
	if url:match("^offline://[%w%-]+%.luarmor%.net/status$") then
		return '{"active":true,"versions":{"3.4":"offline"}}'
	end

	if url:match("^offline://[%w%-]+%.luarmor%.net/") and url:find("/init?", 1, true) then
		return "local:init"
	end

	if url:match("^offline://[%w%-]+%.luarmor%.net/") and url:find("/auth/start/", 1, true) then
		return "local:start"
	end

	local basename = url:match("^[^?]*[/]([^/?]+)")
	local path = basename and "PulseHub/cache/" .. basename

	if path and context.encodedFiles[path] then
		return context.files.readfile(path)
	end

	return nil
end

local OfflineServices = {}

function OfflineServices.create(hostGame, request, diagnostics)
	local hostHttp = hostGame:GetService("HttpService")
	local services = {}
	local gameProxy = {}
	local lookups = {
		FindFirstChild = true, WaitForChild = true,
		FindFirstChildOfClass = true, FindFirstChildWhichIsA = true,
	}

	local function httpGet(_, url)
		local response = request({Url = url, Method = "GET"})

		if not response.Success then
			error("Local resource unavailable", 0)
		end

		return response.Body
	end

	local function httpPost(_, url)
		local route = tostring(url):match("^[^?]+") or tostring(url)
		diagnostics.blocked[OfflineRequests.address(route)] = true
		error("POST unavailable offline", 0)
	end

	local function noKick(_, reason)
		table.insert(diagnostics.kicks, tostring(reason))
		print("[Pulse offline] Local Kick suppressed: " .. tostring(reason))
	end

	local httpProxy = setmetatable({}, {__index = function(_, key)
		if key == "GetAsync" then
			return httpGet
		end

		if key == "RequestAsync" then
			return function(_, options) return request(options) end
		end

		if key == "PostAsync" then
			return httpPost
		end

		if key == "JSONEncode" or key == "JSONDecode" or key == "GenerateGUID" or key == "UrlEncode" then
			return function(_, ...) return hostHttp[key](hostHttp, ...) end
		end

		error("HttpService member unavailable offline: " .. tostring(key), 0)
	end})

	local function protect(value)
		if value == hostHttp then
			return httpProxy
		end

		return value
	end

	local function getService(_, name)
		if name == "HttpService" then
			return httpProxy
		end

		if name == "HttpRbxApiService" then
			error("HTTP API unavailable offline", 0)
		end

		if not services[name] then
			services[name] = hostGame:GetService(name)
		end

		return services[name]
	end

	setmetatable(gameProxy, {__index = function(_, key)
		if key == "HttpRbxApiService" then
			error("HTTP API unavailable offline", 0)
		end

		if lookups[key] then
			local method = hostGame[key]
			return function(_, ...) return protect(method(hostGame, ...)) end
		end

		if key == "GetChildren" or key == "GetDescendants" then
			local method = hostGame[key]
			return function(_, ...)
				local children = method(hostGame, ...)

				for index, child in ipairs(children) do
					children[index] = protect(child)
				end

				return children
			end
		end

		if key == "GetService" or key == "FindService" or key == "service" then
			return getService
		end

		if key == "HttpGet" or key == "HttpGetAsync" then
			return httpGet
		end

		if key == "HttpPost" or key == "HttpPostAsync" then
			return httpPost
		end

		if key == "HttpService" then
			return httpProxy
		end

		local value = hostGame[key]

		if type(value) == "function" then
			return function(_, ...) return value(hostGame, ...) end
		end

		return value
